content.text: Static wide shot of a sunlit temperate forest clearing at midday, tall oaks and beeches, leaves gently swaying in a light breeze, dappled sunlight, small songbirds flitting between branches. The camera does not move. Audio: only natural ambient sound — many songbirds chirping and singing at various distances, soft rustling of leaves in the wind, a gentle breeze. Pure nature field recording. No music, no soundtrack, no score, no human voices, no speech, no footsteps, no people.
